You probably know me from Minecraft and then came to stay for all the other music that gets you working. Or you are just stopping by. Whatever it is, hi, I'm your favourite human, and occasional music man, Daniel. welcome.", "author_profile_picture": "http://localhost:9000/profile-picture/C418.png"}

{"music_id": "1", "music_name": "Key", "music_description": "\u201ckey\u201d is the song that sort of introduces you to the album", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/key.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "2", "music_name": "Door", "music_description": "\u201cDoor\u201d is a little bit of a small medley that welcomes you to the world of Minecraft.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/door.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "3", "music_name": "Subwoofer Lullaby", "music_description": "\u201cSubwoofer Lullaby\u201d is a song I named that way because I always imagine a big speaker somewhere far far in a forest blasting this odd little melody.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/subwoofer-lullaby.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "4", "music_name": "Living Mice", "music_description": "\u201cLiving Mice,\u201d or the opposite would be deadmau5, hah. Joel did help me a bit with making this album, so there\u2019s that reference.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/living-mice.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "5", "music_name": "Moog City", "music_description": "\u201cMoog City\u201d is a fun track. Moog actually contacted me on it, telling me how much they liked it. I\u2019m glad they never found out I actually didn\u2019t make it with a Moog device. I kinda created this song because I ordered a Moog, but I didn\u2019t have it yet.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/moog-city.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "6", "music_name": "Minecraft", "music_description": "\u201cMinecraft\u201d is by far the most minimalist song and also the first song I created for the game. It\u2019s purely pentatonic in scale, builds up very slowly, and then slowly fades away. This is kind of what I built the entire soundtrack around on.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/minecraft.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "7", "music_name": "Oxyg\u00e8ne", "music_description": "\u201cOxyg\u00e8ne\u201d and \u201c\u00c9quinoxe\u201d are naturally references to Jean Michel Jarre.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/oxygene.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "8", "music_name": "\u00c9quinoxe", "music_description": "\u201cOxyg\u00e8ne\u201d and \u201c\u00c9quinoxe\u201d are naturally references to Jean Michel Jarre.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/equinoxe.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "9", "music_name": "Mice On Venus", "music_description": "\u201cMice on Venus\u201d, or Mouse on Mars. MOM is a definite inspiration for me, and this album directly. It\u2019s a highly experimental German musician duo that has been super active in the late 90\u2019s and early 2000\u2019s and I obsessed over their work. The song started as a piano solo, but as game development went on, I added a kind of, uh, addendum to it. A little cheeky piece that kind of says, Minecraft is also quite silly.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/mice-on-venus.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "10", "music_name": "Thirteen", "music_description": "\u201cThirteen\u201d is a creepy little record you can find in Minecraft. I always wanted the player to find it somewhere deep within a cave, because it\u2019s being played by a device, creating a creepy atmosphere. But it turns out it\u2019s just a creepy song being played. We never actually did that in the game though.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/thirteen.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "11", "music_name": "Excuse", "music_description": "\u201cExcuse\u201d was originally intended to be a song for Minecraft\u2019s hell world, the \u201cNether\u201d. However when I started creating this album, I wanted it to be more than just carbon copies of what\u2019s in the game. I wanted to give people more. So I ultimately decided that \u201cExcuse\u201d would be one of several exclusive songs only to be found on this record.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/excuse.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "13", "music_name": "Sweden", "music_description": "\u201cSweden\u201d is by far the most popular song, and I think it\u2019s because of it\u2019s very minimalistic chord progression that you can follow very easily. It is also based on the principle the song \u201cMinecraft\u201d is built on. Slow buildup, slowly fading away.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/sweden.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "14", "music_name": "Cat", "music_description": "\u201cCat\u201d is a whimsical little track. People seem to like it a lot! I don\u2019t know why!", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/cat.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "15", "music_name": "Beginning", "music_description": "\u201cBeginning\u201d because the end is always just the beginning. And with Minecraft, now we do know that this is not the last album and there is more to discover. That\u2019s why I named it that.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/beginning.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "16", "music_name": "Droopy Likes Ricochet", "music_description": "\u201cDroopy Likes Ricochet\u201d and \u201cDroopy Likes your Face\u201d are both songs from \u201clife changing moments seem minor in pictures\u201d. It\u2019s a song I haven\u2019t created for anything in particular, but the first Droopy song ended up in the first official Minecraft game trailer. I get a lot of questions on what Droopy says. To be fair, I don\u2019t know. It\u2019s a sample library that you receive if you buy Kontakt. As far as I know, it\u2019s a toy you could buy in the 80\u2019s or 90\u2019s which says random phrases about itself.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/droopy-likes-ricochet.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "17", "music_name": "Droopy Likes Your Face", "music_description": "\u201cDroopy Likes Ricochet\u201d and \u201cDroopy Likes your Face\u201d are both songs from \u201clife changing moments seem minor in pictures\u201d. It\u2019s a song I haven\u2019t created for anything in particular, but the first Droopy song ended up in the first official Minecraft game trailer. I get a lot of questions on what Droopy says. To be fair, I don\u2019t know. It\u2019s a sample library that you receive if you buy Kontakt. As far as I know, it\u2019s a toy you could buy in the 80\u2019s or 90\u2019s which says random phrases about itself.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-alpha.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-alpha/droopy-likes-your-face.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Alpha", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "18", "music_name": "Ki", "music_description": "\u201cKi,\u201d like \u201cKey,\u201d on the previous album is an introduction to the album. But this time it\u2019s not quiet, somber and welcoming, but dark and foreboding.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/ki.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "19", "music_name": "Alpha", "music_description": "\u201cAlpha\u201d is a medley of past songs. It acts as the score that plays when you \u201cbeat\u201d Minecraft, but it also acts as a celebration of past music from Volume Alpha.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/alpha.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "20", "music_name": "Blind Spots", "music_description": "\u201cBlind Spots\u201d is the first song I wrote with the clear intention of having a unique soundtrack for Minecraft\u2019s \u201ccreative mode\u201d. I tried to create a piece that doesn\u2019t particularly change much, but keeps reiterating on itself, like a constant remixing of its core theme. As the piece ends, it becomes very melancholic and solemn, but quickly returns to being positive. Things end, but that\u2019s not bad.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/blind-spots.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "21", "music_name": "Moog City 2", "music_description": "\u201cMoog City 2\u201d is a recreation of \u201cMoog City\u201d from Minecraft Alpha. However this time I actually did use Moog synthesisers, along a lot of other synths that I acquired over the course of making this album.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/moog-city-2.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "22", "music_name": "Biome Fest", "music_description": "\u201cBiome Fest\u201d is a song that I created when Minecraft Alpha was done, but I felt it had no place anywhere in the game, until the creative mode was sort of reintroduced to the game. It\u2019s one of my favourite songs I\u2019ve ever created. I do love minimalism and achieving tones with just very few notes, and I think this song does that extremely well.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/biome-fest.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "23", "music_name": "Haunt Muskie", "music_description": "\u201cHaunt Muskie\u201d, if I remember correctly, an anagram for Hatsune Miku. Not entirely sure why anymore, but there you go. This song is very nostalgic for me, and I didn\u2019t expect anyone to like it but just me. It turns out it is a little bit popular though. There was this fairly old video game I used to like. Some game where you solve puzzles of broken rollercoasters you have to fix. The music wasn\u2019t particularly good, but the emotion it carried was something I always remembered. \u201cHaunt Muskie\u201d is what I remember that music to be.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/haunt-muskie.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "24", "music_name": "Warmth", "music_description": "\u201cWarmth\u201d plays in the game\u2019s hell. Or as it is called in Minecraft,  \u201cNether\u201d. This song tries to play with the idea that even hell isn\u2019t all bad, and there\u2019s good things to be found. But it\u2019s still a very harsh environment.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/warmth.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "25", "music_name": "Aria Math", "music_description": "\u201cAria Math\u201d is a song full of Pan Drums and old synthesisers rhythmically dancing to ping pong delays. It\u2019s also one of the creative mode songs. I wrote it with the beauty of the more extreme creations in Minecraft. Gigantic statues, entire cities, paintings, people, all recreated in this game. It\u2019s awe inspiring, and that\u2019s what I wanted to kind of symbolise. Not sure if I succeeded?", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/aria-math.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "26", "music_name": "Taswell", "music_description": "\u201cTaswell\u201d is a farewell to a friend I only met for a little bit, but they passed away faster than anyone could have imagined. It was shocking, but I didn\u2019t want to remember them for their death, but the happiness they showed every day of their life.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/taswell.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "27", "music_name": "Beginning 2", "music_description": "\u201cBeginning 2\u201d is just like \u201cBeginning\u201d on Alpha, perhaps the end to the album, or just the beginning. This album is now in the progress of changing tone rapidly, but not before going to \u201cThe End.\u201d", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/beginning-2.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "28", "music_name": "Dreiton", "music_description": "\u201cDreiton\u201d is a remembrance of the times when I wrote albums like Zweitonegoismus. When I was still scared to embrace minimalism and simplicity in music. When I was still keen on making my music as crazy and varied as possible. Turns out there was no reason to have such a fear. And with \u201cDreiton\u201d, the are essentially only two sections on a song that clocks in at over 8 minutes. I hope I accomplished to have repetition that nonetheless isn\u2019t boring in any way. Like all the other \u201ccreative mode\u201d songs, this one is also about the awe of the creativity to be found in Minecraft. At minute 7, the song abruptly builds up to nothing and fades away. Sometimes creativity doesn\u2019t need to have a reason. Sometimes you just build.", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/dreiton.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "29", "music_name": "The End", "music_description": "\u201cThe End\u201d is a 15 minute piece for the namesake in Minecraft, a place called \u201cThe End\u201d, a dark and sinister place full of creepy things called Endermen. Oh, and there\u2019s a dragon. Since The End is also the final stage the player has to go to to \u201cbeat\u201d the game, this piece contains a lot of references to past songs. If you listen closely, you can essentially hear most of Volume Alpha embedded within. After building up the drone, the song breaks, as if some sort of audio device couldn\u2019t handle it anymore. Lastly you hear someone fixing it, and it starts from the beginning. At least in the game. On the album we then go to\u2026", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/the-end.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}

{"music_id": "30", "music_name": "Chirp", "music_description": "\u201cChirp\u201d, which is where we switch to the records you can find in Minecraft as collectibles. Until we get to\u2026", "music_author": "C418", "music_cover_url": "http://localhost:9000/music-cover/volume-beta.jpg", "music_url": "http://localhost:9000/music/volume-beta/chirp.mp3", "music_album": "Volume Beta", "likes": 0, "views": 0, "shares": 0, "comments": 0}
